mostWorthwhile.text: Completing the rover was most worthwhile: the motion connects the assembled wheels and pen to a visible drawing result.

leastWorthwhile.text: Fitting the two guards was straightforward but repetitive; each mainly covered a wheel-side box.

surprise.text: The return spring sits around one guide rod, clarifying its position in the pen assembly.

arbitrary.text: Choosing which guard to fit first felt arbitrary because both were offered and no order was indicated.

continue.text: I would probably continue for another moving creation: the finished drawing rover is appealing, although most choices here simply followed explicit goals.
